sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: Establish a Standing Offer Arrangement to provide goods and services to NSW Health, ensuring qualified suppliers deliver value-for-money, compliant, and efficient solutions to support healthcare operations
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content: The scope includes establishing a Standing Offer Arrangement for the supply of goods and related services to NSW Health Eligible Customers, with one or more suppliers appointed to provide products, support services, maintenance, and associated deliverables in accordance with the requirements specified in the RFT and Part B Requirements Documentation.
